entry.title: AI Is Turning Retail Traders Into DIY Hedge Funds
entry.summary: The rollout of powerful new tools is inspiring a generation of day traders who are trying to crack Wall Street’s secret code and create automated money machines. Bloomberg's Zijia Song explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Parsing SEC EDGAR's Form 4 feed: the edge cases nobody warns you about

entry.title: The Unwind of Situational Awareness' Stock Bets
entry.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, was forced to sell billions of dollars of technology stock bets that had rapidly lost value, as nervous banks began to demand more collateral for his trades. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar breaks down what happened. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Index Ventures, Firm Behind Wiz, Revolut, Raises $2 Billion for Trio of Funds
entry.summary: Index Ventures, an investor in cybersecurity firm Wiz and fintech Revolut, has raised $2 billion in new capital to back startups across multiple stages of development.

entry.title: AI Wunderkind’s Hedge Fund Unravels
entry.summary: A 24-year-old AI wunderkind became one of the market’s most influential investors, until leverage and margin calls forced billions in tech-stock sales. Bloomberg's Sri Natarajan joined Bloomberg Open Interest to explain how a futuristic AI empire collided with one of Wall Street’s oldest and most dangerous mistakes. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness may have sold its public portfolio, but it still has its Anthropic shares
entry.summary: The former OpenAI researcher’s fund was forced to unwind public equities after leveraged public bets plummeted. But he still has cards to play.

entry.title: Marathon Asset Management on Hyperscalers’ Credit Risks
entry.summary: Bruce Richards, Managing Partner and Head of CVC Marathon discusses the current state of credit markets and the cost of capital. With $80 billion in assets under management and extensive Wall Street experience, Richards provided valuable perspectives on market dynamics and financing conditions. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Banks Line Up $15 Billion of Debt for Anthropic With Google Aid
entry.summary: Banks led by Morgan Stanley are in talks to line up $15 billion of debt for an Anthropic PBC data-center project in Texas, backstopped by Alphabet Inc.’s Google, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: Goldman Says Microsoft Shows How Its AI Bet Pays Off
entry.summary: Microsoft Corp. is giving investors clearer signs that it has multiple ways to turn its artificial-intelligence investment into revenue, Goldman Sachs Group Inc. analyst Gabriela Borges said, as the shares surged the most in almost 18 years.
